title: Tparquet - Parquet for time series. Tick data at about half their ZSTD size, lossless, and still Parquet.
author: Daniel_Aperiodic
selftext:
If you want to save some space on your market data hard drive vs parquet, we have a very small fork of parquet libraries/loaders that'll give you \~50% better compression (with pcodec), and we're also backing initiative to make it an official parquet compression codec.

**It'll be actually a couple of bytes of change to switch over when it becomes officially supported.**

All credit goes to Martin Loncaric, the author of pcodec, who's also the maintainer of the excellent reference implementation: [https://github.com/pcodec/pcodec](https://github.com/pcodec/pcodec)

comments.author: QuanTradin
comments.body: tick timestamps already compress well with plain delta encoding, being close to sequential. is most of the 50% coming from the price columns?
